description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80.  A black line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 63) and ends at approximately (1000, 68), showing a gradual increase. A light-gray line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, begins at approximately (1, 66) and ends at approximately (1000, 73), also showing a gradual increase. A blue line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 65) and ends at approximately (1000, 71), with a similar gradual increase. A pink line with triangular markers, representing “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (1, 68) and ends at approximately (1000, 75), exhibiting a gradual increase. Finally, a green line with square markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 72) and ends at approximately (1000, 79), also showing a gradual increase.
